raw_text: China Watch Telegram — Follow-up on the Doklam imagery campaign. Multiple OSINT accounts have now confirmed the footage is recycled 2017 material. The amplification pattern is interesting: Weibo military blogger posts at 0300 UTC, CCTV picks it up one hour later, and Indian Twitter panic begins by 0800. This is a textbook cognitive warfare sequence. The intended effect is not military escalation but erosion of Indian public confidence in border security. Watch for a second wave of content targeting Hindi-language media next.
